text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I don't think I trained hard enough for that last one.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I bet the audience was probably nodding off, what with the race panning out just the way they expected it to.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, never again. No more boring races.
